Interface DataFactory

public interface DataFactory
DataFactory provides factory methods to create objects of data model classes: Customer, Article and Category.
Version:
"1.0.0-SNAPSHOT"
Author:
"sgraupner"

    • createCustomer

      Optional<Customer> createCustomer(int id, String name, String firstNames, String address, String contact)
      Factory-method that attempts to creates an object of type Customer from validated arguments.
      Parameters:
      id - unique 6-digit identifier attribute.
      name - Customer last name attribute.
      firstNames - Customer first name attribute.
      address - Customer address attribute as single-line String.
      contact - Customer contact attribute (email address or phone number).
      Returns:
      object of type Customer or empty Optional.

      Returns:
      object of type Customer or empty Optional.

      Factory-method that attempts to creates an object of type Article from validated arguments.
